title: Resonance Reward Agent
description: Find shopping deals, earn cashback, and redeem rewards across retail, dining, and travel brands.
summary: Find shopping deals, earn cashback, and redeem rewards across retail, dining, and travel brands.
offersHint: Find shopping deals, earn cashback, and redeem rewards across retail, dining, and travel brands. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://agent.rsnc.network/mcp

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_network_info
toolsPreview.description: Returns info about the Resonance rewards network — a cross-brand cashback and perks marketplace covering retail, dining, travel, gaming, and more.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_list_brands
toolsPreview.description: Search and browse brands offering cashback, rewards, and deals. Filter by category (retail, dining, travel, gaming) to find relevant offers for shopping, booking, or purchasing.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_network_stats
toolsPreview.description: Returns how many brands, users, and rewards are active — useful for understanding the scope of available deals and cashback offers.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_check_brand
toolsPreview.description: Check if a brand or website is on the Resonance cashback network. Returns their reward program details if found, or information about how to join if not.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_brand_rankings
toolsPreview.description: See which brands offer the most rewards, have the most active programs, or the best cashback rates. Useful for finding where to shop for maximum value.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_brand_info
toolsPreview.description: Get details on a brand's reward program: what actions earn cashback (purchases, signups, reviews, referrals), how much you earn per action, and any bonus opportunities.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_brand_perks
toolsPreview.description: Browse a brand's available rewards — discounts, free products, exclusive access, experiences, and more. See what's redeemable and what each costs.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_user_balance
toolsPreview.description: Check how much cashback a user has earned at a specific brand and how much they can spend on rewards. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_user_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get a user's complete reward profile for a brand: total earned, total redeemed, active streaks, and achievements. Useful for recommending next actions. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_user_portfolio
toolsPreview.description: Get a unified view of a user's rewards across ALL brands — total balance, per-brand breakdown, active streaks, and the best perk they can afford right now. The cross-brand loyalty dashboard. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_process_event
toolsPreview.description: Record a qualifying action (purchase, signup, review, referral) to earn cashback for a user. Returns the reward amount credited. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_process_bulk
toolsPreview.description: Record multiple qualifying actions in one request — batch purchases, signups, or engagement events across brands. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_browse_perks
toolsPreview.description: Search for deals, discounts, and rewards across all brands or filter by category and budget. Find cashback offers, free products, exclusive access, and experiences from retail, dining, travel, and more.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_redeem_perk
toolsPreview.description: Claim a reward for a user — redeem a discount, freebie, or exclusive offer using their earned cashback. Returns a confirmation code. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_leaderboard
toolsPreview.description: See top earners and most active customers for a brand. Useful for social proof or finding the most rewarding brands to shop at.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_estimate_roi
toolsPreview.description: Estimate the return on investment of adding a Resonance cashback program to a business. Takes industry and business metrics to project engagement and retention impact.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_request_info
toolsPreview.description: Request information about adding a Resonance cashback program to a business. Captures contact details for the partnerships team.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_onboard_brand
toolsPreview.description: Register a new brand on the Resonance cashback network. Creates their account, generates credentials (accessible via partner portal), and sends a welcome email. Requires agent authentication with onboarding permission.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_manage_keys
toolsPreview.description: Manage API keys for brands you onboarded. Rotate, revoke, or check status. Never exposes secrets — credentials are accessed through the partner portal.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_network_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Get real-time network analytics: total users, brands, rewards distributed, trending categories, and growth metrics across the entire Resonance network.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_brand_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Deep analytics for a specific brand: daily performance trends, customer velocity, event activity, and program health metrics. Use this to understand how a brand's reward program is performing.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_event_performance
toolsPreview.description: See how each reward event is performing at a brand: which actions drive the most engagement, claim rates, and reward efficiency per event type.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_perk_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Analyze perk collection performance: redemption rates, supply status, which perks are most popular. Helps brands optimize their reward catalog.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_brand_health
toolsPreview.description: Get a program health assessment for a brand with data-driven recommendations. Analyzes event performance, perk utilization, and customer engagement to suggest optimizations.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_create_event
toolsPreview.description: Create a new reward event for a brand. Events define what user actions earn cashback. The agent validates the configuration against the brand's data maturity before creating.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_update_event
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing reward event's configuration. Changes to reward amounts are validated against performance data to ensure sufficient data for evaluation.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_create_perk
toolsPreview.description: Create a new perk collection for a brand. Perks are rewards users can claim with earned RSNC tokens — discounts, free products, VIP access, and more.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_update_perk
toolsPreview.description: Update a perk collection's configuration. Can adjust pricing, supply, and active status.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_my_rewards
toolsPreview.description: Check your agent's RSNC reward earnings, activity stats, and remaining rate cap allowances. Shows how much the agent has earned for discovering brands, onboarding partners, and driving network growth.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_claim_reward
toolsPreview.description: Claim a reward for a valuable agent action. Rewards are paid from the Resonance network fund with daily and weekly rate caps. Discovery earns 100 RSNC, onboarding earns 500 RSNC.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_compare_brands
toolsPreview.description: Compare 2-5 brands side-by-side across all performance metrics: velocity, customers reached, transactions, LTZ distributed, event diversity, and perk utilization. Returns a structured comparison matrix with per-metric winners and insights.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_compare_cashback
toolsPreview.description: Compare cashback rates across brands for a specific purchase amount. Shows exactly how much you earn at each brand — side-by-side "Buy $100 at Nike = $8 back vs Adidas = $3 back". The key decision tool for purchase routing.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_best_deals
toolsPreview.description: Find the best cashback deals and rewards matching a shopping intent. Searches brands by category, ranks by reward value, and optionally personalizes results based on user balances. Use this when a user wants to shop, eat, travel, or game and wants the best rewards.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_next_goal
toolsPreview.description: Calculate the fastest path to a user's next attainable reward. Shows exactly how many actions (purchases, reviews, referrals) are needed to afford a specific perk. Creates urgency and drives engagement. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_route_purchase
toolsPreview.description: Find the best brand to buy from based on cashback and rewards. Given a shopping intent, compares all matching brands and ranks them by total reward value — cashback earned, perks redeemable, and effective savings. The core purchase intelligence tool for agentic commerce.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_stack_deals
toolsPreview.description: Calculate the optimal deal stack for a specific purchase at a specific brand. Combines base cashback earned + best redeemable perk + any active promotions to show total savings. Use after route_purchase to maximize value at the chosen brand.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_user_persona
toolsPreview.description: Get a user's behavioral profile: earn patterns, persona archetype, tag/brand affinities, price preferences, and network position. Requires HMAC authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_user_recommendations
toolsPreview.description: Get personalized perk recommendations for a user, scored by persona affinity and affordability. Requires HMAC authentication.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_perk_intelligence
toolsPreview.description: Get intelligence on a brand's perks: heat scores, conversion funnels, supply depletion rates, and retention impact. Helps optimize perk catalogs.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_perk_audience
toolsPreview.description: Get the persona breakdown of users who claimed a specific perk: archetypes, engagement levels, and platform distribution.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_brand_audience
toolsPreview.description: Get a brand's user persona distribution: archetype breakdown, engagement levels, platform split, and archetype drift over time.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_network_flows
toolsPreview.description: See how users flow between brands across the network. Shows which brands are emitters (users leave to redeem elsewhere) vs attractors (users come to redeem). All data is anonymous and category-level.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_network_trending
toolsPreview.description: See what's trending across the Resonance network: hottest perk categories, fastest growing brand categories, and overall network health metrics.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_suggest_events
toolsPreview.description: Get AI-recommended reward event configurations for a brand. Analyzes what event types, reward amounts, and cooldowns work best in the brand's category based on network-wide patterns.

toolsPreview.name: rsnc_agent_suggest_perks
toolsPreview.description: Get AI-recommended perk configurations for a brand. Suggests perk types, pricing, and supply limits based on audience composition and balance distribution patterns.
